Te damos la bienvenida a Los Santos  Cuando un joven estafador callejero, un ladrón de bancos retirado y un psicópata aterrador se ven involucrados con lo peor y más desquiciado del mundo criminal, el gobierno de los EE. UU. y la industria del espectáculo, deberán llevar a cabo una serie de peligrosos golpes para sobrevivir en una ciudad implacable en la que no pueden confiar en nadie. Y mucho menos los unos en los otros.
  Los jugadores actuales de PC pueden transferir su progreso del Modo Historia de GTAV y sus personajes y progreso de GTA Online mediante una tranferencia única desde la versión original de GTAV a GTAV Enhanced. 
  Gráficos impresionantes  Niveles de fidelidad y rendimiento mejorados, con nuevos modos de gráficos que ofrecen funciones de trazado de rayos, tales como oclusión ambiental e iluminación global, sombras y reflejos con trazado de rayos, compatibilidad con AMD FSR y NVIDIA DLSS, y mucho más*.
  Carga más rápida  Entra en la acción rápidamente, ya que el mundo de Los Santos y el condado de Blaine ahora se carga más rápido que nunca mediante SSD y DirectStorage en dispositivos compatibles.
  Controles inmersivos  Experimenta nuevos niveles de reacción con la resistencia dinámica gracias a los gatillos adaptativos del mando inalámbrico DualSense™: siente desde el daño direccional hasta los efectos atmosféricos, los baches de las carreteras, las explosiones y mucho más*.
  Audio 3D  Audio mejorado con soporte para Dolby Atmos y mayor fidelidad de voz, cinemáticas y música*. Oye los sonidos del mundo con una precisión milimétrica, desde la aceleración de un supercoche robado hasta los disparos de un tiroteo cercano, el estruendo de un helicóptero sobre tu cabeza y mucho más.
  Grand Theft Auto Online  Disfruta de la experiencia de GTA Online, un universo dinámico y en constante evolución para hasta 30 jugadores, donde podrás pasar de ser un estafador callejero a convertirte en el capo de tu propio imperio criminal.
  Disfruta de nuevas mejoras para vehículos de alto rendimiento y del creador de profesiones. Además, podrás acceder a todas las actualizaciones, expansiones y contenidos de GTA Online publicados desde el lanzamiento, tanto en solitario como con tus amigos. Lleva a cabo elaborados golpes cooperativos, participa en carreras acrobáticas llenas de adrenalina, compite en Modos Adversario especiales o pasa el tiempo en espacios sociales como clubes nocturnos, salones recreativos, fiestas en áticos, reuniones automovilísticas y mucho más.
  Contenido exclusivo  Visita Hao's Special Works en el Car Meet de LS, donde encontrarás nuevas mejoras para vehículos de élite y modificaciones exclusivas. Después, participa con estos vehículos de alto rendimiento en nuevas carreras, contrarrelojes y mucho más.
  Nuevo creador de profesiones  Ponte en marcha en GTA Online con las herramientas del oficio. Accede rápidamente a uno de los cuatro negocios (Motero, Ejecutivo, Propietario de un club nocturno o Traficante de armas) y elige entre una selección de propiedades, potentes vehículos y armamento para poner en marcha tu negocio.
  Nuevo diseño del menú  Accede al instante a todo lo que te ofrece GTA Online directamente desde el menú principal, incluidas las actualizaciones más recientes y populares.
  Accede a todas las actualizaciones actuales y previas  Sumérgete en más de 40 actualizaciones masivas y las que vendrán, que incluyen desde dirigir una instalación de operaciones encubiertas en Agents of Sabotage, rastrear y atrapar a los más buscados del sur de San Andreas en Bottom Dollar Bounties, desenmascarar a policías corruptos y cárteles de asesinos en Asalto a Cluckin' Bell, hasta robar los vehículos más codiciados de Los Santos en The Chop Shop. Todo esto y más disponible junto con una amplia variedad de carreras, modos, actividades y espacios sociales para disfrutar solo o con amigos, que incluyen clubes nocturnos, salones recreativos, fiestas en áticos, encuentros automovilísticos y mucho más.

Bienvenue à Los Santos  Lorsqu'un jeune arnaqueur, un braqueur de banque à la retraite et un terrible psychopathe se retrouvent piégés par de grands criminels, le gouvernement américain et l'industrie du divertissement, ils doivent effectuer une série de braquages pour survivre dans une ville sans pitié où ils ne peuvent faire confiance à personne, et encore moins à leurs compagnons.
  Les joueurs actuels sur PC peuvent transférer leurs progressions dans GTAV et GTA Online, ainsi que leurs personnages, de la version originale de GTAV vers GTAV Version améliorée via une migration unique. 
  Des graphismes exceptionnels  Fidélité et performances optimisées grâce à de nouveaux modes graphiques, dont des fonctionnalités en ray-tracing telles que l'occlusion ambiante et l'illumination globale, le ray-tracing sur les ombres et reflets, la compatibilité avec AMD FSR et NVIDIA DLSS, et plus.*
  Chargement accéléré  L'accès à Los Santos et Blaine County est plus rapide que jamais grâce aux temps de chargement réduits via les technologies SSD et DirectStorage sur les systèmes compatibles.
  Commandes immersives  Réactivité optimisée grâce au retour haptique et à la résistance dynamique des gâchettes adaptatives de la manette sans fil DualSense™ : ressentez chaque moment, des dégâts directionnels aux effets météorologiques, des sensations sur la route aux explosions et bien plus.*
  Audio 3D  Audio amélioré via la compatibilité avec Dolby Atmos et fidélité supérieure des dialogues, des cinématiques et de la musique.* Écoutez les sons du monde avec une précision absolue : le vrombissement d'une supersportive volée, les détonations d'une fusillade voisine, le rugissement d'un hélicoptère au-dessus de votre tête et plus.
  Grand Theft Auto Online  Découvrez GTA Online, un univers en ligne dynamique et en perpétuelle évolution pouvant accueillir jusqu'à 30 joueurs, dans lequel vous pourrez passer de petite frappe à dirigeant d'un véritable empire du crime.
  Profitez de nouvelles améliorations puissantes de véhicules et d'avantages comme l'éditeur de carrière, ainsi que des améliorations de gameplay, extensions et contenus de GTA Online qui sont disponibles depuis la sortie, accessibles en solo ou entre amis. Préparez des braquages en coopération, disputez des courses casse-cou démentes, essayez-vous à des modes rivalité uniques, ou détendez-vous dans les espaces sociaux comme les boîtes de nuit, les salles d'arcade, ou lors de soirées dans la suite avec terrasse, des rassemblements de véhicules et bien plus.
  Du contenu exclusif  Accédez à Hao's Special Works dans le salon auto de Los Santos, qui propose des améliorations d'élite et des modifications exclusives. Vous pourrez piloter ces véhicules ultraperformants dans des courses et nouveaux contre-la-montre d'HSW et plus.
  Nouvel éditeur de carrière  Commencez dans GTA Online sur de bonnes bases. Choisissez l'une des quatre carrières proposées : motard, col blanc, patron d'une boîte de nuit ou expert en trafic d'armes, et faites votre choix parmi une liste de propriétés, de véhicules puissants et d'armes pour lancer votre entreprise.
  Nouveau menu  Accédez immédiatement à tout ce que propose GTA Online depuis le menu principal, comme aux dernières mises à jour les plus populaires.
  Accès à toutes les mises à jour d'hier et d'aujourd'hui  Découvrez plus de 40 mises à jour conséquentes, sans compter celles à venir : gérez un centre névralgique pour l'organisation d'opérations secrètes dans Agents saboteurs, traquez et capturez les ennemis publics du sud de San Andreas dans Primes de Bottom Dollar, révélez des flics corrompus et un cartel assassin dans le raid de l'usine Cluckin' Bell, dérobez les véhicules les plus convoités de Los Santos lors de vols audacieux dans Casse de haut vol... Tout cela et bien plus, comme une large sélection de courses, modes, activités et espaces sociaux dont vous pourrez profiter en solo ou entre amis, dont des boîtes de nuit, des salles d'arcade, des soirées dans la suite avec terrasse, des rassemblements de véhicules et bien plus.

Willkommen in Los Santos  Als ein junger Straßengauner, ein ehemaliger Bankräuber und ein beängstigender Psychopath sich mit einigen der furchteinflößendsten und durchgeknalltesten Gestalten der Unterwelt, der US-Regierung und der Unterhaltungsindustrie einlassen, müssen sie eine Reihe von gefährlichen Überfällen durchziehen, um in einer skrupellosen Stadt zu überleben, in der sie niemandem vertrauen können – am allerwenigsten einander.
  Spieler, die bereits auf PC spielen, können ihren Spielstand im Story-Modus von GTAV sowie ihren Spielfortschritt und ihre Charaktere in GTA Online einmalig von der Legacy-Version von GTAV auf GTAV Enhanced übertragen. 
  Atemberaubende Grafik  Visuelle Verbesserungen und eine höhere Leistung mit neuen Grafikmodi, die Raytracing-Features wie Umgebungsverdeckung und globale Beleuchtung, das Raytracing von Schatten und Spiegelungen, Unterstützung für AMD FSR sowie NVIDIA DLSS und mehr bieten.*
  Kürzere Ladezeiten  Schnellerer Zugang zur Action, da die Welt von Los Santos und Blaine County schneller geladen wird als jemals zuvor, wenn eine SSD und DirectStorage auf unterstützten Geräten genutzt wird.
  Immersive Steuerung  Fühle eine neue Dimension des Spielens dank dynamischem Widerstand über die adaptiven Trigger des DualSense™Wireless-Controllers. Spüre Schadensrichtung, Wettereffekte, grobe Straßenbeläge, Explosionen und vieles mehr.*
  3D-Audio  Verbesserter Ton mit Dolby-Atmos-Unterstützung und verbesserte Wiedergabetreue von Sprache, Zwischensequenzen und Musik.* Genieße die Klangkulisse der Welt mit höchster räumlicher Präzision: den Motor eines gestohlenen Supersportwagens, das knatternde Gewehrfeuer um die Ecke, das Dröhnen eines Helikopters über dir und mehr.
  Grand Theft Auto Online  Erlebe GTA Online, ein dynamisches und ständig wachsendes Online-Universum für bis zu 30 Spieler, in dem du vom einfachen Straßengauner zum Drahtzieher eines eigenen kriminellen Imperiums aufsteigen kannst.
  Freue dich auf neue hochleistungsfähige Fahrzeug-Upgrades und Verbesserungen wie den Career Builder sowie alle Gameplay-Verbesserungen, Erweiterungen und Inhalte, die seit der Veröffentlichung von GTA Online präsentiert wurden und die allein oder mit Freunden erlebt werden können. Ziehe herausfordernde kooperative Raubüberfälle durch, tritt in adrenalingeladenen Stuntrennen an, behaupte dich in einzigartigen Gegner-Modi oder hänge mit anderen in Social Spaces wie Nachtclubs oder Spielhallen, bei Penthouse-Partys oder Autotreffen ab und vieles mehr.
  Exklusive Inhalte  Besuche Hao's Special Works im Los Santos Car Meet, wo dich neue hochkarätige Fahrzeug-Upgrades und exklusive Modifikationen erwarten. Nutze diese hochleistungsfähigen Fahrzeuge anschließend in HSW-Rennen, neuen Zeitrennen und mehr.
  Neuer Career Builder  Starte mit der notwendigen Ausstattung in GTA Online. Suche dir eines von vier Unternehmen aus – Biker, Führungskraft, Nachtclubbesitzer oder Waffenschmuggler – und wähle Immobilien, leistungsstarke Fahrzeuge und die notwendige Feuerkraft, um dein Unternehmen in Schwung zu bringen.
  Neues Menü-Design  Erhalte direkt über das Hauptmenü sofortigen Zugriff auf alles, was GTA Online zu bieten hat – unter anderem auch auf die neuesten und beliebtesten Updates.
  Zugang zu allen aktuellen und früheren Updates  Tauche ein in über 40 riesige Updates und weitere, die noch folgen werden. Leite in „Agents of Sabotage“ eine verdeckte Operation, spüre in „Bottom Dollar Bounties“ die meistgesuchten Personen im südlichen San Andreas auf und nimm sie fest, entlarve im Rahmen des „Cluckin-Bell'-Überfalls“ korrupte Cops und Killerkartelle oder stiehl in „The Chop Shop“ die begehrtesten Fahrzeuge in Los Santos. Darüber hinaus erwartet dich eine breite Auswahl an Rennen, Modi, Aktivitäten und Social Spaces, die du allein oder mit Freunden nutzen kannst, wie Nachtclubs, Spielhallen, Penthouse-Partys, Autotreffen und viele mehr.

Welcome to Los Santos  When a young street hustler, a retired bank robber, and a terrifying psychopath find themselves entangled with some of the most frightening and deranged elements of the criminal underworld, the U.S. government, and the entertainment industry, they must pull off a series of dangerous heists to survive in a ruthless city in which they can trust nobody — least of all each other.
  Current PC players can transfer both GTAV Story Mode progress and GTA Online characters and progression with a one-time migration from the legacy version of GTAV to GTAV Enhanced. 
  Stunning Visuals  Enhanced levels of fidelity and performance with new graphics modes including ray tracing features such as ambient occlusion and global illumination, ray traced shadows and reflections, support for AMD FSR and NVIDIA DLSS, and more.*
  Faster Loading  Quicker access to the action as the world of Los Santos and Blaine County load in faster than ever before by using SSD and DirectStorage on supported devices.
  Immersive Controls  Feel new levels of responsiveness with dynamic resistance via the Adaptive Triggers on the DualSense™ wireless controller, from directional damage to weather effects, rough road surfaces to explosions, and much more.*
  3D Audio  Enhanced audio with support for Dolby Atmos and improved fidelity of speech, cinematics, and music.* Hear the sounds of the world with pinpoint precision: the throttle of a stolen supercar, the rattle of neighboring gunfire, the roar of a helicopter overhead, and more.
  Grand Theft Auto Online  Experience GTA Online, a dynamic and ever-evolving online universe for up to 30 players, where you can rise from street-level hustler to become a kingpin of your own criminal empire.
  Enjoy new high-performance vehicle upgrades and improvements like the Career Builder as well as all GTA Online gameplay upgrades, expansions, and content released since launch, ready to enjoy solo or with friends. Pull off daring co-operative Heists, enter adrenaline-fueled Stunt Races, compete in unique Adversary Modes, or hang out in social spaces including nightclubs, arcades, penthouse parties, car meetups, and much more.
  Exclusive Content  Step into Hao’s Special Works at the Los Santos Car Meet, featuring elite new upgrades and exclusive modifications. Then take these high-performance vehicles into HSW races, new time trials, and more.
  New Career Builder  Get started in GTA Online with the tools of the trade. Quickly choose from one of four businesses — Biker, Executive, Nightclub Owner, or Gunrunner — and select from properties, powerhouse vehicles, and weaponry to kick-start your enterprise.
  New Menu Design  Immediately access everything GTA Online has to offer right from the main menu, including the latest and most popular updates.
  Access to All Current and Previous Updates  Dive into more than 40 massive updates with more to come, featuring everything from running a covert ops installation in Agents of Sabotage, to tracking down and dragging in Southern San Andreas' most wanted in Bottom Dollar Bounties; exposing corrupt cops and killer cartels in The Cluckin' Bell Farm Raid, to daring robberies of the most coveted vehicles in Los Santos in The Chop Shop. All this and more available alongside a wide range of races, modes, activities, and social spaces to enjoy solo or with friends — including nightclubs, arcades, penthouse parties, car meetups, and much more.

Ti diamo il benvenuto a Los Santos  Un giovane truffatore, un rapinatore di banche in pensione e uno spaventoso psicopatico si ritrovano nel mirino degli elementi più discutibili del mondo del crimine, del governo statunitense e dell'industria dello spettacolo. Per sopravvivere dovranno mettere in atto una serie di audaci colpi in una città spietata dove non possono fidarsi di nessuno, men che meno gli uni degli altri.
  I giocatori su PC possono trasferire i progressi di gioco della modalità Storia di GTAV e i personaggi e progressi di GTA Online con un trasferimento unico dalla versione classica di GTAV a GTAV Enhanced. 
  Grafica incredibile  Fedeltà e prestazioni migliorate grazie a modalità grafiche che includono funzioni di ray tracing come occlusione ambientale e illuminazione globale, ombre e riflessi in ray tracing, supporto per AMD FSR e NVIDIA DLSS e altro.*
  Caricamenti più veloci  Entra subito nel mondo di Los Santos e Blaine County grazie ai tempi di caricamento estremamente ridotti utilizzando SSD e DirectStorage sui dispositivi idonei.
  Comandi immersivi  Scopri nuove frontiere di immersività grazie alla resistenza dinamica fornita dai grilletti adattivi del controller wireless DualSense™, che si attiveranno per danni direzionali, effetti atmosferici, strade irregolari, esplosioni e molto altro ancora.*
  Audio 3D  Audio migliorato con supporto a Dolby Atmos e fedeltà migliorata per dialoghi, filmati e musica.* Ascolta i suoni del mondo di gioco con una precisione assoluta: il rombo del motore di una supercar rubata, il fragore dei colpi di arma da fuoco, il frastuono di un elicottero sopra la tua testa e molto altro.
  Grand Theft Auto Online  Goditi GTA Online, un universo online dinamico e in continua evoluzione per un massimo di 30 giocatori: lanciati in una scalata verso il successo in cui partirai nei panni di un semplice truffatore di strada fino a diventare re del tuo impero criminale.
  Scopri nuovi miglioramenti per veicoli ad alte prestazioni e novità come la Selezione carriera, oltre a perfezionamenti al gameplay di GTA Online, espansioni e contenuti pronti da giocare sia in solitaria che con gli amici. Collabora con gli altri per mettere a segno dei Colpi, partecipa a incredibili gare stunt, competi in modalità Competizione uniche o socializza in night club, sale giochi, feste in attici meravigliosi, autoraduni e molti altri luoghi unici.
  Contenuti esclusivi  Fai un salto da Hao's Special Works all'Autoraduno di Los Santos e approfitta di potenziamenti d'élite e modifiche esclusive. Sfrutta i tuoi veicoli dalle altissime prestazioni in nuove gare HSW, prove a tempo e altro ancora.
  Nuova Selezione carriera  Inizia la tua avventura in GTA Online. Scegli tra una delle quattro attività disponibili (biker, dirigente, manager di night club o trafficante) e scegli tra una selezione di proprietà, veicoli di pregio e armi per iniziare la tua impresa col piede giusto.
  Nuovo menu  Accedi immediatamente a tutto ciò che GTA Online ha da offrire dal menu principale, tra cui gli ultimissimi aggiornamenti.
  Accesso a tutti gli aggiornamenti  Immergiti in più di 40 incredibili aggiornamenti con una varietà pazzesca. Passa da gestire un'operazione segreta in Agents of Sabotage a rintracciare e consegnare i criminali più ricercati di Southern San Andreas in Bottom Dollar Bounties; denuncia poliziotti corrotti e assassini del cartello in Assalto a Cluckin' Bell e ruba i veicoli più desiderati di Los Santos in The Chop Shop. Avrai a tua disposizione una vasta gamma di gare, modalità, attività e spazi sociali da goderti in solitaria o con gli amici, tra cui night club, sale giochi, feste in attici meravigliosi, autoraduni e molto altro.

game.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2
game.description:
Just Updated  Join your friends and keep on truckin' together in 8 player Convoy multiplayer mode, now available!
 
  Give American Truck Simulator a test drive  Start your new truck empire in the United States! Try the demo of American Truck Simulator and visit the Steam store page.
 
 
 
  About the Game  
 
 Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore from the UK, Belgium, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, and many more, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits. If you’ve got what it takes to be part of an elite trucking force, get behind the wheel and prove it! Key Features: 
   Transport a vast variety of cargo across more than 60 European cities.
   Run your own business which continues to grow even as you complete your freight deliveries.
   Build your own fleet of trucks, buy garages, hire drivers, manage your company for maximum profits.
   A varied amount of truck tuning that range from performance to cosmetic changes.
   Customize your vehicles with optional lights, bars, horns, beacons, smoke exhausts, and more.
   Thousands of miles of real road networks with hundreds of famous landmarks and structures.
   Play, deliver and chat online together with your friends in the Convoy multiplayer mode!   World of Trucks 
 Take advantage of additional features of Euro Truck Simulator 2 by joining our online community on World of Trucks, our center for virtual truckers all around the world interested in Euro Truck Simulator 2 and future SCS Software's truck simulators. 
 
   Use in-game Photo Mode to capture the best moments and share them with thousands of people who love trucks.
   Favorite the images you like the most and return to them anytime in the future. 
   Discuss the screenshots with everyone using World of Trucks. 
   See the best images hand-picked by the game creators in Editor's Pick updated almost every day. Try to get your own screenshot on this list!
   Upload and use your custom avatar and license plate in the game.
   More features coming soon!  
 To join World of Trucks, simply sign up with your Steam account on the join page.
 
  World of Trucks is an optional service, registration on World of Trucks isn't required to play the game.

  关于游戏  
 
 像公路之王一样在欧洲穿行， 将价值不菲的货物完美送抵远方！往返于英国，比利时，德国，意大利，荷兰，波兰等众多城市；您的耐力，技巧，速度都被您发挥到了极致！想知道如何成为一名卡车运输界的行家里手，用您的车轮来证明吧！ 主要特色：   在超过60个欧洲城市中运送大量货物
   运送货物,经营公司,逐渐发展
   建立自己的卡车团队,购买自己的车库，雇佣司机，管理公司以赚取最大利润
   对卡车进行全方位定义，从性能到外观
   真实卡车配件系统，保险杠，喇叭，灯光，排气管等等
   上万公里的真实路段以及数百处著名地标建筑等。   World of Trucks（卡车世界）

   使用游戏中的“拍照模式”捕捉精彩瞬间并与成千上万的卡车爱好者分享你的照片。
   为您最喜爱的图片点赞，方便今后随时回来看看。
   与 World of Trucks 中的其他玩家一同讨论截图。
   “编者精选”几乎每日更新，您可在此查看游戏创作人员精挑细选的最佳图片。试着让您的屏幕截图登上此精选列表！
   上传并在游戏中使用自定义卡车和牌照。
   更多特色功能，敬请期待！  
 只需在加入页面上用您的 Steam 帐户进行注册，即可进入我们的 World of Trucks！
 
  World of Trucks 为可选服务，您无需进行注册也可游玩游戏。

 Voyagez à travers l'Europe en tant que roi de la route, un chauffeur routier qui livre d'importantes cargaisons vers des destinations très lointaines ! Avec des douzaines de villes à explorer du Royaume-Uni, de Belgique, d'Allemagne, d'Italie, des Pays-Bas, de Pologne et de bien d'autres pays, votre endurance, vos talents et votre rapidité seront poussés dans leur retranchements.    Lancez votre propre entreprise qui s'étend même lorsque vous êtes sur les routes à effectuer des livraisons.
   Construisez votre propre flotte de camions, achetez des garages, engagez des chauffeurs, gérez votre entreprise pour maximiser vos profits.
   De nombreux choix pour personnaliser les camions, des changements esthétiques aux améliorations des performances.
   Customisez votre véhicule avec des lumières, des gyrophares, des klaxons, des sorties d'échappement optionnels et bien plus encore.
   Des milliers de kilomètres du véritable réseau routier européen et des centaines de panoramas et lieux reconnaissables.

  Infos zum Spiel  
 
 Reisen Sie als König der Straßen durch Europa, als Lastwagenfahrer, der wichtige Ladungen in weiter Ferne zustellt! Mit dutzenden Städten aus Großbritannien, Belgien, Deutschschland, Italien, den Niederlanden, Polen und vielen mehr wird Ihre Ausdauer, Ihr Geschick und Ihre Geschwindigkeit bis zum Äußersten gefordert.    Führen Sie Ihr eigenes Unternehmen, das mit jeder erfolgreichen Lieferung weiter wächst.
   Stellen Sie Ihren eigenen Fuhrpark zusammen, kaufen Sie Garagen, stellen Sie Fahrer ein, holen Sie den maximalen Profit aus Ihrem Geschäft.
   Vielfältige Möglichkeiten des LKW-Tunings, von Leistung bis zum Aussehen.
   Rüsten Sie Ihr Fahrzeug mit optionalen Lampen, Gittern, Hupen, Rundumleuchten, Auspuffanlagen und mehr aus.
   Tausende Meilen echter Straßennetze mit hunderten bekannten Wahrzeichen und Gebäuden.

   Construisez votre propre flotte de camions, achetez des garages, engagez des chauffeurs, gérez votre entreprise pour maximiser vos profits.

   Customisez votre véhicule avec des lumières, des gyrophares, des klaxons, des sorties d'échappement optionnels et bien plus encore.
   Des milliers de kilomètres du véritable réseau routier européen et des centaines de panoramas et lieux reconnaissables.

Mit dutzenden Städten aus Großbritannien, Belgien, Deutschschland, Italien, den Niederlanden, Polen und vielen mehr wird Ihre Ausdauer, Ihr Geschick und Ihre Geschwindigkeit bis zum Äußersten gefordert.   Om spillet  Rejs på tværs af Europa som konge af vejen, en lastbilschauffør, der leverer vigtig last over imponerende afstande! Med snesevis af byer at udforske fra Storbritannien, Belgien, Tyskland, Italien, Holland, Polen og mange flere, vil din udholdenhed, dygtighed og hastighed alle blive skubbet til deres grænser. Hvis du har det, der skal til, for at være en del af en elitelastbilhold, så sæt dig bag rattet og bevis det!
  Nøglefunktioner:    Transporter et stort udvalg af gods på tværs af mere end 60 europæiske byer.
    Drive din egen virksomhed, som fortsætter med at vokse, selvom du fuldfører dine fragtleverancer.
    Byg din egen flåde af lastbiler, køb garager, ansæt chauffører, administrer din virksomhed for maksimal fortjeneste.
    En varieret mængde af trucktuning, der spænder fra ydeevne til kosmetiske ændringer.
    Tilpas dine køretøjer med valgfri lygter, stænger, horn, fyrtårn, røgudstødninger og mere.
    Tusindvis af miles af rigtige vejnetværk med hundredvis af berømte vartegn og strukturer.
    Spil, lever og chat online sammen med dine venner i Convoy multiplayer-tilstand!
    World of Trucks  Udnyt ekstra funktioner i Euro Truck Simulator 2 ved at deltage i vores online-fællesskab på World of Trucks, vores center for virtuelle lastbilchauffører over hele verden, der er interesseret i Euro Truck Simulator 2 og fremtidige SCS Softwares lastbilsimulatorer.
    Brug fototilstand i spillet til at fange de bedste øjeblikke og dele dem med tusindvis af mennesker, der elsker lastbiler.
    Favorit de billeder, du kan lide mest, og vend tilbage til dem når som helst i fremtiden.
    Diskuter skærmbillederne med alle, der bruger World of Trucks.
    Se de bedste billeder håndplukket af spilskaberne i Editor's Pick, der opdateres næsten hver dag. Prøv at få dit eget skærmbillede på denne liste!
    Upload og brug din brugerdefinerede avatar og nummerplade i spillet.
    Flere funktioner kommer snart!

Con decine di città da esplorare dal Regno Unito, Belgio, Germania, Italia, Paesi Bassi, Polonia e molte altre, la tua resistenza, abilità e velocità dovranno spingersi al limite. Se hai quello che serve per far parte di una forza di autotrasporto d'élite, mettiti al volante e dimostralo!

  Gestisci un'attività in proprio che continua a crescere mentre porti a termine le tue consegne di merci.
  Costruisci la tua flotta di camion, acquista garage, assumi autisti, gestisci la tua azienda per ottenere il massimo profitto.
  Un'ampia gamma di modifiche al camion che spaziano dalle prestazioni alle modifiche estetiche.
  Personalizza i tuoi veicoli con luci, barre, clacson, fari, marmitte anti-fumo e altro ancora.
  Migliaia di chilometri di vere e proprie reti stradali con centinaia di famosi punti di riferimento e strutture.
  Gioca, consegna e chatta online insieme ai tuoi amici nella modalità multigiocatore Convoy!

game.description:
Draw & Guess is an online party game where you can draw and guess in various modes with up to 16 players.
 
 Show off your art skills (for better or worse), test your analytical mind, and create some memorably fun moments!
 
    GAME MODES   Whisper  (4-16 players)
 Just as in  Telephone  and  Chinese Whispers , everyone draws and guesses at the same time in an attempt to keep the results true to the original prompt. Try to avoid turning "bunny" into "killer monster truck".
 
  Stage  (2-16 players)
 Your classic match of drawing and guessing! One player draws while the others try to guess the correct word. The faster the word is guessed correctly, the more points you earn!
 
  Lounge  (1-16 players)
 Collaborate with others with no time restraints. Get creative and work together on creating something unique.
 
  Robot  (1-16 players)
 In this drawing-only mode, our AI friend (don't worry, no AI-generated art here) GU-355 will try to guess your word prompt. The easier to recognize your piece, the more points you'll get!
 
  NEW: Battle Royale  (10-63 players)
 Compete with up to 62 other players and try to make it to the final round for a special reward. All you have to do is draw images our guessing unit can identify better than those of other players.
 
    FEATURES  If simply drawing and guessing is too easy, scale up the challenge by adjusting the settings. Try  Pixel Art ,  Invisible Lines , or  Gravity ! If that's not enough, adjust the timer for short-speed rounds or drawing marathons. You can also create and share your own wordlists with other players.
 
 Make some new drawing friends over on our discord!  https://discord.gg/VBs82c5dGB 
 Visit the Draw & Guess website:  https://drawandguess.com/press  
 Twitter:  https://twitter.com/Draw_Guess

localized_description.text:
“你画我猜”是一款在线派对游戏，最多可 16 人在一起绘画和猜测彼此的画作内容，有多种模式可供选择。快来展现您的艺术才能（好坏不论）、试炼分析思维，创造出趣味横生、令人难忘的精彩瞬间！
 
  
   游戏模式  
  接龙模式 （4-16 名玩家）
 这个模式和"拷贝不走样"类似。每位玩家既要作画，也要猜别人画的是什么，让最后的结果尽可能接近最初的主题词。可别把喜羊羊画成了怪物卡车哦！
 
  竞猜模式 （2-16 名玩家）
 绘画和猜画的经典搭配！一位玩家作画的同时，其他玩家要努力猜出画的是什么。越快猜出那个正确的词，获得的分数就越多！
 
  茶绘模式 （1-16 名玩家）
 与小伙伴们一起画画，不限时。发挥创意，共同创作出独一无二的作品吧！
 
  机器人模式 （1-16 名玩家）
 这个模式仅限绘画，GU-355 型 AI 机器眼（放心，与人工智能生成图像无关）会尝试根据您的画作猜测主题词。您的画作越容易辨认，您获得的分数就越多！
 
  新增：大逃杀 （10-63 位玩家）
 与最多 62 名玩家竞争，尽您所能撑到最终回合，赢取特别奖励。您所要做的就是让您的画作比别的画家的更容易让我们的猜画机器人识别出来。
 
  
   功能亮点  
 如果您觉得只是画画和猜画太容易了，还可以通过调整设置来增加挑战。试试看像素艺术、隐形线条，或是 重力作用！如果这些还不够，那就调整计时器，玩一局速度与激情的短时比赛，或是来一场酣畅的绘画马拉松吧。您还可以创建自己的词库列表并与其他玩家分享哦。
 
 
 欢迎加入我们的 Discord 社区，寻找玩家： https://discord.gg/VBs82c5dGB 
 访问“你画我猜”游戏网站： https://drawandguess.com/press

Draw & Guess es un divertidísimo juego de fiesta en línea en el que puedes dibujar y adivinar en varios modos con hasta 16 jugadores.
 
 Demuestra tus destrezas artísticas (para bien o para mal), pon a prueba tu mente analítica y crea momentos inolvidables en los que abunden las carcajadas.  MODOS DE JUEGO   Malentendido  (Entre 4 y 16 jugadores)

 Utilisez vos talents artistiques (que vous en ayez ou non), testez votre esprit analytique et amusez-vous comme jamais !
 
   MODES DE JEU  
  Esquisse  (De 4 à 16 artistes)
 Tout comme dans le téléphone arabe, tout le monde dessine et devine en même temps, tout en essayant de reproduire le mot original. Essayez de ne pas transformer un « lapin » en « camion tueur ».
 
  En scène  (De 2 à 16 artistes)
 Un jeu classique de dessin et de devinette ! Une personne dessine tandis que les autres essaient de trouver le bon mot. Plus vite vous devinerez le mot correct, plus vous gagnerez de points !
 
  Coopération   (De 1 à 16 artistes)
 Collaborez avec les autres sans restrictions de temps. Faites preuve de créativité et travaillez ensemble pour créer quelque chose d'unique.
 
  Robot  (De 1 à 16 artistes)
 Dans ce mode où vous ne ferez que dessiner, l'IA (ne vous inquiétez pas, elle ne générera aucun dessin), GU-355 essaiera de deviner votre mot. Plus votre dessin sera facile à reconnaître, plus vous gagnerez de points !
 
  NOUVEAU : Battle Royale  (De 10 à 63 artistes)
 Affrontez jusqu'à 62 personnes et tentez d'atteindre la manche finale pour remporter une récompense spéciale.

   SPIELMODI  
  Flüsterpost  (4–16 Spieler)
 Stille Post oder eher Stilvolle Post? In diesem Modus malt und ratet ihr alle zur gleichen Zeit, gebt eure Werke an den Nachbarn weiter und hofft dabei, dass aus dem anfänglichen Osterhasen am Ende kein fallschirmspringender Monstertruck geworden ist.
 
  Rampenlicht  (2–16 Spieler)
 Der Klassiker unter den Malspielen! Ein Spieler zeichnet und alle anderen versuchen, das Wort zu erraten. Je schneller sie dabei sind, desto höher steigt ihr Punktekonto.

  Robo  (1–16 Spieler)
 In diesem Modus versucht unsere KI-Einheit GU-355, eure Zeichnungen zu entschlüsseln. Je besser sie euer Werk zuordnen kann, desto mehr Punkte bekommt ihr.

 Hier geht's zu unserer Website:  https://drawandguess.com/press

Draw & Guess is an online party game where you can draw and guess in various modes with up to 16 players.
 
 Show off your art skills (for better or worse), test your analytical mind, and create some memorably fun moments!
 
    GAME MODES   Whisper  (4-16 players)
 Just as in  Telephone  and  Chinese Whispers , everyone draws and guesses at the same time in an attempt to keep the results true to the original prompt. Try to avoid turning "bunny" into "killer monster truck".
 
  Stage  (2-16 players)
 Your classic match of drawing and guessing! One player draws while the others try to guess the correct word. The faster the word is guessed correctly, the more points you earn!
 
  Lounge  (1-16 players)
 Collaborate with others with no time restraints. Get creative and work together on creating something unique.
 
  Robot  (1-16 players)
 In this drawing-only mode, our AI friend (don't worry, no AI-generated art here) GU-355 will try to guess your word prompt. The easier to recognize your piece, the more points you'll get!
 
  NEW: Battle Royale  (10-63 players)
 Compete with up to 62 other players and try to make it to the final round for a special reward. All you have to do is draw images our guessing unit can identify better than those of other players.
 
    FEATURES  If simply drawing and guessing is too easy, scale up the challenge by adjusting the settings. Try  Pixel Art ,  Invisible Lines , or  Gravity ! If that's not enough, adjust the timer for short-speed rounds or drawing marathons. You can also create and share your own wordlists with other players.
 
 Make some new drawing friends over on our discord!  https://discord.gg/VBs82c5dGB 
 Visit the Draw & Guess website:  https://drawandguess.com/press  
 Twitter:  https://twitter.com/Draw_Guess

Draw & Guessは、いろんなモードで最大16人まで遊べるお絵かき伝言ゲームのオンラインパーティーゲーム版です。
 
 絵心があっても無くても）絵の才能を披露したり、分析能力を発揮しながら、思い出に残る楽しいひとときを過ごしましょう！
 
    ゲームモード   伝言 （4～16人）
 電話や伝言ゲームのように、最初の言葉ができるだけ変化しないようにみんなが描いて答えていきます。「うさぎ」が「凶悪な怪物トラック」なんかに変化しないよう注意してくださいね。
 
  ステージ  （2～16人）
 お絵かき伝言ゲームの定番です！一人が絵を描いて、みんなでその言葉を当てます。正しい答えが出るまでの時間が短いほど点数が高くなります！
 
  ラウンジ （1～16人）
 時間制限なしで、他のプレイヤーと協力して遊びます。みんなで一緒にクリエイティブになって、面白いものを作って遊びましょう。
 
  ロボット （1～16人）
 この「描くだけ」のモードでは、AIロボットのGU-355が（AI生成アートではないのでご安心を）あなたの言葉を当てます。どれだけわかりやすかったかが、高得点につながるカギになります！
 
  新機能：バトルロワイヤル （10～63人）
 最大62人と競い合って、最終ラウンドまで生き残れば特別な報酬がゲットできます。やり方は簡単、他のプレイヤーよりも回答ユニットが認識しやすい絵を描くだけです。
 
    特徴  普通の伝言ゲームで満足できない場合は、設定を調整して難易度を上げてみましょう。ドット絵、透明の線、重力に挑戦してみてください！それでも足りない場合は、タイマーを変えてラウンドの時間を短くしたり、お絵描きマラソンなどもおすすめです。また、単語リストを作成して、他のプレイヤーと共有することもできます。
 
 Discordコミュニティに参加してプレーヤーを見つけましょう： https://discord.gg/VBs82c5dGB 
 Draw & Guess公式サイトはこちら： https://drawandguess.com/press

 In this drawing-only mode, our AI friend (don't worry, no AI-generated art here) GU-355 will try to guess your word prompt. The easier to recognize your piece, the more points you'll get!
 
  NEW: Battle Royale  (10-63 players)
 Compete with up to 62 other players and try to make it to the final round for a special reward. All you have to do is draw images our guessing unit can identify better than those of other players.
 
    FEATURES  If simply drawing and guessing is too easy, scale up the challenge by adjusting the settings. Try  Pixel Art ,  Invisible Lines , or  Gravity ! If that's not enough, adjust the timer for short-speed rounds or drawing marathons. You can also create and share your own wordlists with other players.
 
 Make some new drawing friends over on our discord!  https://discord.gg/VBs82c5dGB 
 Visit the Draw & Guess website:  https://drawandguess.com/press  
 Twitter:  https://twitter.com/Draw_Guess

game.title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild
game.description: Never before have you experienced a hunting game like theHunter: Call of the Wild. Plunge into an atmospheric open world, teeming with life: from the majestic true-to-life animals to the rustling of leaves above you as you stalk your prey. You can decide to hunt on your own or join up and hunt together with friends. Just remember, you are not just a visitor in this world, you are a living and breathing part of it. As you finally spot the majestic crown of your first red deer through the brush, the feeling is indescribable.

  关于游戏 在这个风光旖旎又栩栩如生的开放世界中，体验与众不同、身临其境的狩猎快感——我们与游戏社区携手合作，定期更新。可选择投身于单人狩猎模式，或与好友分享终极狩猎体验。
 
       
  在开放世界中体验身临其境的狩猎快感 
 
 自由徜徉于精心制作的游戏环境中，探索不同地区和生物群落中的独特动植物。体验复杂的动物行为、变化无常的天气、日夜更迭交替、模拟弹道效果、栩栩如生的叫声及随风飘来的猎物气息。
 
       
  狩猎体验，由你做主 
 
 自主选择各种武器、弹药和装备，创造终极狩猎体验。游戏中有白尾兔、绿头鸭、黑熊、麋鹿和驼鹿等各种各样的野生动物，你需要制定策略，选择合适的武器，根据各种动物的独特行为和所处环境追踪、引诱和伏击它们。
 
       
  通过玩家合作不断升级 
 
 theHunter: Call of the Wild与社区紧密合作，提供丰富的付费和免费内容，包括保护区、狩猎装备、武器包和战利品小屋。随着新内容的定期更新，玩家可收获不断升级的游戏体验。
 
       
  战利品荣耀 
 
 每次狩猎都蕴含是一个独一无二的故事。在宽敞的战利品小屋中展示最珍贵的收获，或者在壁炉边放松，计划下一次狩猎之旅，让自己在莱顿湖和赫希费尔登保护区的胜利故事永远流传。
 
       
  合作无间 
 
 在精彩纷呈的狩猎区中体验最多8人的在线多人游戏。与好友通力合作制定狩猎策略，或奋力拼搏竞争，一举拿下最令人印象深刻的战利品。只要你的狩猎队伍中有一位成员拥有任一付费版DLC保护区权限，你就可以进入该保护区中游戏。

Discover an atmospheric hunting game like no other in this realistic, stunning open world – regularly updated in collaboration with the community. Immerse yourself in the single player campaign, or share the ultimate hunting experience with friends. 
       
 Roam freely across meticulously crafted environments and explore a diverse range of regions and biomes, each with its own unique flora and fauna. Experience the intricacies of complex animal behavior, dynamic weather events, full day and night cycles, simulated ballistics, highly realistic acoustics, and scents carried by the wind. 
       
 Select from a variety of weapons, ammunition, and equipment to create the ultimate hunting experience. With a diverse range of wildlife, including Jackrabbits, Mallard Ducks, Black Bears, Elk, and Moose, you will need to strategically match prey to weaponry to successfully track, lure, and ambush animals based on their unique behavior and environment.
       
 Developed in close collaboration with the community, theHunter: Call of the Wild offers a wealth of paid and free content, including reserves, hunting equipment, weapon packs, and trophy lodges. With new content and updates regularly added, players can look forward to a constantly evolving experience.
       
 Every hunt has a unique story to tell. Immortalize your tales of triumph from the Layton Lake and Hirschfelden reserves by displaying your most prized trophies in your spacious Trophy Lodge, or relax by the fireplace as you plan your next hunt.  
       
 Experience online multiplayer for up to eight players in breathtaking hunting reserves. Collaborate and strategize with friends, or compete to take down the most impressive trophy. You can access any paid DLC reserve as long as one member of your hunting party owns it.

Descubre un atmosférico juego de caza sin parangón en un mundo abierto realista y sobrecogedor que se actualiza a menudo en colaboración con la comunidad. Sumérgete en la campaña de un jugador o comparte la experiencia definitiva de caza con amigos. 
       

  LA EXPERIENCIA DE CAZA EN MUNDO ABIERTO MÁS REALISTA 
 
 Pasea sin restricciones por los entornos meticulosamente creados y explora una diversa variedad de regiones y biomas, cada uno con su flora y fauna únicas. Descubre las complejidades del comportamiento animal, los eventos climáticos dinámicos, los ciclos completos de noche y día, la balística simulada, los sonidos hiperrealistas y los aromas que transporta el viento.
        

 TÚ CAZAS. TÚ ELIGES 
 
 Elige entre una variedad de armas, munición y equipo para vivir la experiencia de caza definitiva. Con una amplia variedad de vida salvaje, que incluye liebres de cola blanca, ánades reales, osos negros, wapitís y alces, necesitarás planear de antemano qué equipo llevar para rastrear, atraer y emboscar con éxito a tus presas en función de sus comportamientos y el entorno. 
       
 
 CRECIENDO A TRAVÉS DE LA COLABORACIÓN ENTRE JUGADORES 
 
 TheHunter: Call of the Wild es un desarrollado en estrecha colaboración con la comunidad, que ofrece abundante contenido gratuito y de pago, lo que incluye reservas, equipo de caza, packs de armas y pabellones de trofeos. Con el nuevo contenido y las frecuentes actualizaciones, los jugadores vivirán una experiencia en constante evolución.
 
       
  HAZ HONOR A LA CAZA 
 
 Cada cacería tiene una historia única por contar. Inmortaliza tus relatos de triunfo en las reservas del lago Layton y Hirschfelden al exhibir tus trofeos más preciados en el espacioso pabellón de trofeos o relájate junto al fuego mientras planeas tu próxima cacería.
 
       
  JUNTOS ES MEJOR 
 
 Vive la experiencia multijugador en línea para hasta ocho jugadores en reservas de caza espectaculares. Colabora y crea estrategias con amigos o compite para conseguir el trofeo más impresionante. Puedes acceder a cualquier reserva de un DLC de pago siempre que un miembro del grupo de caza lo tenga.

Découvrez un jeu de chasse immersif au monde ouvert enchanteur et réaliste qui est régulièrement mis à jour en collaboration avec la communauté. Plongez dans l’immersion totale de la campagne en solo ou partagez une expérience de jeu conviviale avec vos amis.
 
       
  UNE EXPÉRIENCE DE CHASSE EN MONDE OUVERT HYPERRÉALISTE 
 
 Baladez-vous librement dans des environnements méticuleusement travaillés et explorez une grande variété de régions et biomes différents, chacun possédant une faune et une flore unique. Observez des animaux aux comportements subtils et complexes dans un environnement enrichi d’événements météorologiques dynamiques, avec un cycle jour-nuit abouti, une balistique simulée, une acoustique hautement réaliste et un système d’odeurs portées par le vent. 
 
       
  VOUS CHASSEZ. VOUS CHOISISSEZ. 
 
 Choisissez parmi une vaste sélection d’armes, de munitions et d’équipement pour personnaliser au maximum votre expérience de chasse. Face à une grande diversité d’animaux sauvages, dont des lièvres, des colverts, des ours noirs, des wapitis et des élans, vous devrez préparer stratégiquement votre armement afin de parvenir au mieux à traquer, attirer et embusquer vos proies en vous adaptant à leur environnement et leur comportement unique.
 
       
  UNE ÉVOLUTION AVEC LA COLLABORATION DES JOUEURS 
 
 Développé en étroite collaboration avec la communauté des joueurs, theHunter: Call of the Wild propose énormément de contenu payant comme gratuit, dont des réserves, de l’équipement de chasse, des packs d’armes et des loges de trophées. Grâce à des mises à jour de contenu régulières, les joueurs peuvent s’attendre à une expérience en constante évolution.
 
       
  HONOREZ LA CHASSE 
 
 Chaque partie de chasse est une histoire unique. Immortalisez vos triomphes aux réserves de Layton Lake et Hirschfelden en exposant vos meilleurs trophées dans votre luxueuse loge de trophées, ou bien reposez-vous près du feu tandis que vous planifiez votre prochaine escapade. 
 
       
  ENCORE MIEUX À PLUSIEURS 
 
 Profitez d’une expérience multijoueur en ligne pouvant avec jusqu’à huit joueurs dans des réserves de chasse à couper le souffle. Coopérez et élaborez des stratégies avec vos amis ou affrontez-les pour savoir qui rapportera le trophée le plus impressionnant. Vous pouvez accéder à n’importe quel DLC payant, tant qu’un membre de votre groupe de chasse le possède.

Erlebe ein außergewöhnlich stimmungsvolles Jagdspiel in einer realistischen offenen Welt und freue dich auf regelmäßige Updates, die in Zusammenarbeit mit der Community entstehen. Tauche in die Einzelspielerkampagne ab oder teile das ultimative Jagderlebnis mit Freunden.
 
       
  DAS REALISTISCHSTE OPEN-WORLD-JAGDERLEBNIS, DAS ES GIBT 
 
 Durchstreife liebevoll gestaltete Umgebungen und erkunde eine große Bandbreite von Regionen und Biomen mit jeweils einzigartiger Flora und Fauna. Entdecke das komplexe Zusammenspiel von aufwendig simuliertem Tierverhalten, dynamischen Wetterereignissen, vollständigen Tag-Nacht-Zyklen, wirklichkeitsnaher Ballistik, hochrealistischer Akustik und Gerüchen, die vom Wind getragen werden.
 
       
  JAGE, WIE ES DIR GEFÄLLT 
 
 Wähle aus einer Vielzahl von Waffen, Munitionsarten und Ausrüstungsgegenständen, um dein ganz persönliches Jagderlebnis zu schaffen. Die große Bandbreite an möglicher Beute, von Präriehasen oder Stockenten über Schwarzbären bis hin zu Wapitis und Elchen, macht es notwendig, deine Bewaffnung für jede Wildart strategisch auszuwählen. Nur so kann es dir gelingen, Tiere entsprechend ihrem individuellen Verhalten und Lebensraum aufzuspüren, anzulocken und zu überraschen.
 
       
  WEITERENTWICKLUNG UNTER MITARBEIT DER SPIELER 
 
 theHunter: Call of the Wild wird in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Community entwickelt und bietet eine Fülle von Gratis- und Bezahlinhalten, etwa Reviere, Jagdausrüstung, Waffenpakete und Trophäenhütten. Ständig kommen neue Inhalte und Updates hinzu, sodass das Spielerlebnis sich stetig weiterentwickelt.
 
       
  JAGDEHRE 
 
 Jede Jagd hat eine ganz eigene Geschichte zu erzählen. Verewige deine Erfolgsgeschichten aus den Jagdrevieren Layton Lake und Hirschfelden, indem du deine wertvollsten Trophäen in einer eigenen geräumigen Trophäenhütte zur Schau stellst. Oder erhole dich am Kamin und plane den nächsten Jagdausflug.
 
       
  GEMEINSAM STARK 
 
 Erlebe Mehrspielerpartien mit bis zu acht Teilnehmern in atemberaubenden Jagdrevieren. Arbeitet zusammen, entwickelt Strategien oder wetteifert darum, wer die schönste Trophäe nach Hause bringt. Du kannst jedes kostenpflichtige DLC-Jagdrevier betreten, solange ein Mitglied deiner Jagdgesellschaft den Inhalt besitzt.

Desfruta deste fascinante jogo de caça sem igual e do seu realista e deslumbrante mundo aberto, que é atualizado com regularidade em colaboração com a comunidade. Deixa-te levar pela campanha para um jogador, ou partilha a derradeira experiência de caça com amigos.
 
       
  A EXPERIÊNCIA DE CAÇA EM MUNDO ABERTO MAIS REALISTA DE SEMPRE 
 
 Explora livremente vários ambientes detalhados e percorre um vasto leque de regiões e biomas, cada um com flora e fauna típicas. Desfruta da peculiaridade dos diferentes comportamentos animais, dos fenómenos meteorológicos dinâmicos, do ciclo de rotação da Terra completo, da balística simulada, da acústica realista e dos aromas transportados pelo vento. 
 
       
  CAÇA À TUA MANEIRA 
 
 Tens à tua disposição um vasto arsenal de armas, munição e equipamento para criar a derradeira experiência de caça. As presas são diversas, desde Lebres, Patos-reais, Ursos-negros, Cervos e Alces, por isso terás de selecionar o armamento correto para lhes apanhar o rasto, as atrair e emboscar, tendo ainda em conta o seu comportamento e ambiente únicos.
 
       
  SUPERA-TE EM COLABORAÇÃO COM A COMUNIDADE 
 
 O thehunter: Call of the Wild foi desenvolvido em colaboração com a comunidade e oferece uma variedade de conteúdo pago e grátis, incluindo reservas, equipamento de caça, pacotes de armas e salas de troféus. Desfruta de uma experiência em evolução constante graças às atualizações e novidades regulares.
 
       
  HONRA A CAÇA 
 
 Cada caçada tem por detrás uma história única. Recorda as tuas histórias triunfantes nas reservas de Layton Lake e Hirschfelden ao exibir os troféus de que mais te orgulhas na tua espaçosa Sala de Troféus, ou relaxa à lareira enquanto planeias a próxima caçada. 
 
       
  A UNIÃO FAZ A FORÇA 
 
 Joga o modo multijogador online com até 8 jogadores em reservas de caça de cortar a respiração. Colabora e define estratégias com amigos ou compete pelo mais impressionante dos troféus. Para aceder a reservas de algum DLC pago, basta que um membro do grupo de caça o tenha.

Join our Discord     
 
  ゲームについて リアルかつ美しいオープンワールドで、他にはない趣ある狩りゲームを体験しましょう。ゲームはコミュニティと連携して定期的にアップデート。シングルプレイヤーキャンペーンにのめり込んでも、究極の狩り体験を友達と共有しても、お楽しみ頂けます。
 
       
  超リアルなオープンワールド狩り体験 
 
 綿密に作りこまれた世界を自由に歩き回り、それぞれめずらしい動植物が待ち受けるさまざまな地域やバイオームを探索しましょう。動物たちの複雑な行動、ダイナミックな天気事象、完全な昼夜の周期、シミュレーションされた弾道、リアルな音響効果、風によって運ばれるにおいなど、細部まで体験できます。 
 
       
  狩りの選択はあなた次第 
 
 幅広い武器、弾薬、装備から選択し、究極の狩り体験を作り出しましょう。オジロジャックウサギ、マガモ、アメリカグマ、アカシカ、ヘラジカなど、待ち受けるのは多様な野生生物。ユニークな習性や環境に合わせた動物の追跡、おびき寄せ、待ち伏せを行うには、獲物に合った武器を戦略的に選ぶ必要があります。
 
       
  プレイヤーとの協力で進化 
 
 theHunter: Call of the Wildでは、保護区、狩り装備、武器パック、トロフィーロッジなど、たくさんの有料および無料コンテンツをご用意しています。新たなコンテンツとアップデートが定期的に追加されるため、プレイヤーは常に進化する体験を満喫できます。
 
       
  狩りを賞賛 
 
 どんな狩りにも語るべき物語があります。広々としたトロフィーロッジに貴重なトロフィーを展示して、レイトン湖やヒルシュフェルデン保護区での偉業の物語に不朽の名声を与えましょう。次の狩りの計画を練りつつ、暖炉のそばでくつろぐのもまた一興。
 
       
  仲間がいればより楽しい 
 
 息を飲むほど美しい保護区にて、最大8名のプレイヤーで遊べるオンラインマルチプレイを体験しましょう。フレンドと一緒に協力して戦略を練ったり、見事なトロフィーをめぐって競い合ったりして楽しめます。有料DLC保護区は、狩り仲間のうち1人が所有してさえいれば、全員にアクセスが与えられます。

Entdecke das komplexe Zusammenspiel von aufwendig simuliertem Tierverhalten, dynamischen Wetterereignissen, vollständigen Tag-Nacht-Zyklen, wirklichkeitsnaher Ballistik, hochrealistischer Akustik und Gerüchen, die vom Wind getragen werden.
 
       
  JAGE, WIE ES DIR GEFÄLLT 
 
 Wähle aus einer Vielzahl von Waffen, Munitionsarten und Ausrüstungsgegenständen, um dein ganz persönliches Jagderlebnis zu schaffen. Die große Bandbreite an möglicher Beute, von Präriehasen oder Stockenten über Schwarzbären bis hin zu Wapitis und Elchen, macht es notwendig, deine Bewaffnung für jede Wildart strategisch auszuwählen. Nur so kann es dir gelingen, Tiere entsprechend ihrem individuellen Verhalten und Lebensraum aufzuspüren, anzulocken und zu überraschen.
 
       
  WEITERENTWICKLUNG UNTER MITARBEIT DER SPIELER 
 
 theHunter: Call of the Wild wird in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Community entwickelt und bietet eine Fülle von Gratis- und Bezahlinhalten, etwa Reviere, Jagdausrüstung, Waffenpakete und Trophäenhütten. Ständig kommen neue Inhalte und Updates hinzu, sodass das Spielerlebnis sich stetig weiterentwickelt.
 
       
  JAGDEHRE 
 
 Jede Jagd hat eine ganz eigene Geschichte zu erzählen. Verewige deine Erfolgsgeschichten aus den Jagdrevieren Layton Lake und Hirschfelden, indem du deine wertvollsten Trophäen in einer eigenen geräumigen Trophäenhütte zur Schau stellst. Oder erhole dich am Kamin und plane den nächsten Jagdausflug.
 
       
  GEMEINSAM STARK 
 
 Erlebe Mehrspielerpartien mit bis zu acht Teilnehmern in atemberaubenden Jagdrevieren. Arbeitet zusammen, entwickelt Strategien oder wetteifert darum, wer die schönste Trophäe nach Hause bringt. Du kannst jedes kostenpflichtige DLC-Jagdrevier betreten, solange ein Mitglied deiner Jagdgesellschaft den Inhalt besitzt.

  Acerca do jogo Desfruta deste fascinante jogo de caça sem igual e do seu realista e deslumbrante mundo aberto, que é atualizado com regularidade em colaboração com a comunidade. Deixa-te levar pela campanha para um jogador, ou partilha a derradeira experiência de caça com amigos.
 
       
  A EXPERIÊNCIA DE CAÇA EM MUNDO ABERTO MAIS REALISTA DE SEMPRE 
 
 Explora livremente vários ambientes detalhados e percorre um vasto leque de regiões e biomas, cada um com flora e fauna típicas. Desfruta da peculiaridade dos diferentes comportamentos animais, dos fenómenos meteorológicos dinâmicos, do ciclo de rotação da Terra completo, da balística simulada, da acústica realista e dos aromas transportados pelo vento. 
 
       
  CAÇA À TUA MANEIRA 
 
 Tens à tua disposição um vasto arsenal de armas, munição e equipamento para criar a derradeira experiência de caça. As presas são diversas, desde Lebres, Patos-reais, Ursos-negros, Cervos e Alces, por isso terás de selecionar o armamento correto para lhes apanhar o rasto, as atrair e emboscar, tendo ainda em conta o seu comportamento e ambiente únicos.
 
       
  SUPERA-TE EM COLABORAÇÃO COM A COMUNIDADE 
 
 O thehunter: Call of the Wild foi desenvolvido em colaboração com a comunidade e oferece uma variedade de conteúdo pago e grátis, incluindo reservas, equipamento de caça, pacotes de armas e salas de troféus. Desfruta de uma experiência em evolução constante graças às atualizações e novidades regulares.
 
       
  HONRA A CAÇA 
 
 Cada caçada tem por detrás uma história única. Recorda as tuas histórias triunfantes nas reservas de Layton Lake e Hirschfelden ao exibir os troféus de que mais te orgulhas na tua espaçosa Sala de Troféus, ou relaxa à lareira enquanto planeias a próxima caçada. 
 
       
  A UNIÃO FAZ A FORÇA 
 
 Joga o modo multijogador online com até 8 jogadores em reservas de caça de cortar a respiração. Colabora e define estratégias com amigos ou compete pelo mais impressionante dos troféus. Para aceder a reservas de algum DLC pago, basta que um membro do grupo de caça o tenha.

  Om spillet Opdag et stemningsmættet jagtspil, der ikke bliver overgået af andre i sin realistiske og smukke åbne spilverden – der jævnligt opdateres i samarbejde med fællesskabet. Fordyb dig selv i singleplayer-kampagnen eller del den ultimative jagtoplevelse med dine venner.
 
       
  DEN MEST REALISTISKE JAGTOPLEVELSE I EN ÅBEN VERDEN 
 
 Vandr frit rundt i nøje designede miljøer, og udforsk et stort udvalg af regioner og biomer med hver deres eget plante- og dyreliv. Oplev dyrs komplekse adfærdsmønstre, dynamiske vejrforhold, hele dag- og natcyklusser, simuleret ballistik, realistisk akustik og dufte båret af vinden. 
 
       
  DIN JAGT. DIT VALG 
 
 Vælg mellem et stort udvalg af våben, ammunition og udstyr for at skabe den ultimative jagtoplevelse. Med et bredt udvalg af dyreliv inkl. præriehare, gråand, sort bjørn, elg og kronhjort skal du strategisk udvælge det rette våben til dit bytte for at spore og overrumple dyrene baseret på deres unikke adfærd og miljø.
 
       
  UDVIKLING GENNEM SPILLERSAMARBEJDE 
 
 theHunter: Call of the Wild er fremstillet i samarbejde med spillerne og byder på et væld af betalt og gratis indhold inkl. reservater, jagtudstyr, våbenpakker og trofæhytter. Der føjes jævnligt nyt indhold og opdateringer til, så spillerne kan se frem til en spiloplevelse, der hele tiden udvikler sig.
 
       
  VIS RESPEKT FOR JAGTEN 
 
 Hver jagt fortæller sin egen historie. Forevig dine fortællinger fra Layton Lake- og Hirschfelden-reservaterne ved at fremvise dine flotteste trofæer i din hytte, eller slap af ved ildstedet, mens du planlægger din næste jagt. 
 
       
  BEDRE SAMMEN 
 
 Oplev online multiplayer for op til otte spillere i smukke jagtreservater. Samarbejd og læg planer med dine venner, eller dyst om at nedlægge det mest imponerende trofæ. Du har adgang til alle betalte DLC-reservater, så længe ét af medlemmerne i din jagtgruppe ejer det.

  Informazioni sul gioco Scopri un suggestivo gioco di caccia unico nel suo genere, con un open world realistico, aggiornato costantemente insieme alla community. Immergiti nella campagna in solitaria, oppure goditi l’esperienza di caccia definitiva insieme ai tuoi amici.
 
       
  L’ESPERIENZA DI CACCIA OPEN WORLD PIÙ REALISTICA 
 
 Esplora ambienti meticolosamente ricostruiti ed esplora numerose regioni e biomi, ciascuno dotato della propria flora e fauna specifica. Affronta le complessità dei comportamenti animali, eventi meteorologici dinamici, cicli giorno-notte completi, balistica simulata, suoni realistici e profumi portati dal vento. 
 
       
  LA TUA CACCIA, LE TUE REGOLE 
 
 Crea la tua esperienza di caccia definitiva scegliendo tra un fornito arsenale di armi, munizioni ed equipaggiamenti. Lepri, germani reali, orsi neri, wapiti, alci e molto altro... Dovrai scegliere le strategie e le armi più adatte per rintracciare, attirare e tendere agguati alle prede, ciascuna col suo comportamento e il suo ambiente unico.
 
       
  IN EVOLUZIONE CON IL CONTRIBUTO DEI GIOCATORI 
 
 Sviluppato in stretta collaborazione con la sua community, theHunter: Call of the Wild offre un’ampia selezione di contenuti sia gratuiti che a pagamento, incluse riserve, attrezzature di caccia, pacchetti di armi e sale trofei. I nuovi contenuti e gli aggiornamenti pubblicati regolarmente ti garantiranno un’esperienza in continua evoluzione.
 
       
  ONORA LA CACCIA 
 
 Ogni battuta di caccia ha la sua storia da raccontare. Rendi immortali le tue gesta di trionfo dal Layton Lake alle riserve di Hirshfelden esponendo i tuoi trofei più preziosi nella tua sala dedicata, oppure rilassati accanto al camino mentre progetti la tua prossima battuta.
 
       
  MEGLIO IN COMPAGNIA 
 
 Prova l’esperienza multigiocatore online con fino a otto amici in riserve mozzafiato. Collabora e pianifica strategie con i tuoi amici, oppure sfidatevi l’un l’altro per la preda più impressionante. Potrete accedere a qualunque riserva DLC, purché almeno un membro della tua compagnia di caccia la possieda.

game.brief: Never before have you experienced a hunting game like theHunter: Call of the Wild. Plunge into an atmospheric open world, teeming with life: from the majestic true-to-life animals to the rustling of leaves above you as you stalk your prey. You can decide to hunt on your own or join up and hunt together with friends. Just remember, you are not just a visitor in this world, you are a living and breathing part of it. As you finally spot the majestic crown of your first red deer through the brush, the feeling is indescribable.

game.title: Death Stranding: Director's Cut
game.description:
Death Stranding is an action game set in a post-apocalyptic United States. Players control Sam Porter Bridges, a courier tasked with reconnecting isolated cities via a communication network while delivering essential cargo. The gameplay blends traversal, resource management, and narrative elements, with a focus on social connectivity through asynchronous multiplayer. It is known for its unique mechanics, atmospheric world, and philosophical themes. The Director's Cut includes more character action, extended storylines through new missions and a unique Social Strand System to stay connected with other players around the globe.

Sam Bridges must brave a world utterly transformed by the Death Stranding. Carrying the disconnected remnants of our future in his hands, he embarks on a journey to reconnect the shattered world one step at a time.

With spectral creatures plaguing the landscape, and humanity on the verge of a mass extinction, it’s up to Sam to journey across the ravaged continent and save mankind from impending annihilation.

What is the mystery of the Death Stranding? What will Sam discover on the road ahead? An unprecedented gameplay experience holds these answers and more.

game.brief:
Death Stranding is an action game set in a post-apocalyptic United States. Players control Sam Porter Bridges, a courier tasked with reconnecting isolated cities via a communication network while delivering essential cargo. The gameplay blends traversal, resource management, and narrative elements, with a focus on social connectivity through asynchronous multiplayer. It is known for its unique mechanics, atmospheric world, and philosophical themes. The Director's Cut includes more character action, extended storylines through new missions and a unique Social Strand System to stay connected with other players around the globe.

Sam Bridges must brave a world utterly transformed by the Death Stranding. Carrying the disconnected remnants of our future in his hands, he embarks on a journey to reconnect the shattered world one step at a time.

With spectral creatures plaguing the landscape, and humanity on the verge of a mass extinction, it’s up to Sam to journey across the ravaged continent and save mankind from impending annihilation.

What is the mystery of the Death Stranding? What will Sam discover on the road ahead? An unprecedented gameplay experience holds these answers and more.

还是沉沦于自己黑暗的冲动中呢……

——决定结局的，自然是作为主人公的你。

game.title: YOU and ME and HER: A Love Story
game.description:
A visual novel that pushes the boundaries of the format in unique and stunning ways, YOU and ME and HER: A Love Story has to be played to be believed. When Shinichi decides to help the class outcast Aoi, he enlists the help of Miyuki, the most popular girl in school. But when romance enters the picture, the triangle becomes unstable and the future becomes uncertain. Gorgeous artwork by Tsuji Santa and full voice acting by the original Japanese VA cast make YOU and ME and HER a love story you’ll never forget. Story 
  Life is like a staircase. You just gotta keep climbing. Otherwise, if you start to overthink it, you'll have trouble taking the next step. 
 
 Shinichi wants nothing more than to lead a quiet life. Though he was once close friends with Miyuki, the most popular girl in school, his desire for normalcy now keeps them from being anything more than classmates.
 
 Everything changes, however, one day on the roof, when the class oddball, Aoi, suddenly tries to kiss him. Miyuki appears just in time to stop her, but afterward, Shinichi feels the urge to bring some light to this friendless girl's eyes. He enlists Miyuki's aid, and thus, a trio is born.
 
 The days pass, and little by little, Aoi learns what it means to be friends. But at the same time, long-dormant feelings awaken in Miyuki's heart. As the distance between her and Shinichi shrinks, the hard-earned bonds the three share begin to fray.
 
 Miyuki or Aoi－when the time comes, which will Shinichi choose? Game Description 
  YOU and ME and HER: A Love Story  is a multi-path visual novel from acclaimed developer Nitro+. It features beautiful artwork, music, and Japanese voice acting with full English text. Direct the story by making decisions at key points in the narrative. The ending is yours to decide.

《君与彼女与彼女之恋》是由Nitro+制作的ADV游戏，于2013年06月28日发售。
每天，仿 佛走台阶一般的度过。
简直像背景一般毫无个性的男主角须须木心一，和学校人气偶像的曾根美雪虽然是青梅竹马，但因为不想引人注目以及成长隔阂的因素，基本上不与她来往，就这样做为普通同学度过平凡的每一天。
一天，心一被好友曙雄太郎叫到了天台上，在那里却碰上了无法融入班级的电波女向日葵。
“要来，哔哩哔哩吗？”葵一面说着，一面向惊慌失措的心一索吻。突然出现的青梅竹马美雪以意想不到的方式（对葵称心一是自己的男朋友），为心一解围，不过葵此后却缠上了心一。
葵没 有朋友，也没有正常人应有的情感，为了挽救这个电波女，心一拜托美雪一起帮助葵如何融入常人的生活。就这样，三人的命运就此联系起来。葵逐渐的摆脱电波，向着正常女生方向发展，美雪对于心一的心意也逐渐显露出来，不断地缩小与心一的隔阂。好不容易成为朋友的三人，逐渐陷入尴尬的境地。
本以为能一直在一起的三人，却再也不能走到一起，心一会选择谁，美雪亦或是葵？
Galgame君与彼女与彼女之恋的剧情就此展开。

Life is like a staircase. You just gotta keep climbing. Otherwise, if you start to overthink it, you'll have trouble taking the next step.

Shinichi wants nothing more than to lead a quiet life. Though he was once close friends with Miyuki, the most popular girl in school, his desire for normalcy now keeps them from being anything more than classmates.

Everything changes, however, one day on the roof, when the class oddball, Aoi, suddenly tries to kiss him. Miyuki appears just in time to stop her, but afterward, Shinichi feels the urge to bring some light to this friendless girl's eyes. He enlists Miyuki's aid, and thus, a trio is born.

The days pass, and little by little, Aoi learns what it means to be friends. But at the same time, long-dormant feelings awaken in Miyuki's heart. As the distance between her and Shinichi shrinks, the hard-earned bonds the three share begin to fray.

Miyuki or Aoi－when the time comes, which will Shinichi choose?

毎日は、階段のように過ぎていく。
每天，仿佛走台阶一般的度过。


まるでモブのように無個性な主人公・心一。
宛如路人一般缺乏个性的男主角・心一。

学園のヒロイン・美雪とは幼馴染みだが、目立ちたくないがために声をかけることもなく、ただのクラスメイトの1人として、平凡な日々を過ごしていた。
虽然和学园的偶像・美雪是青梅竹马，但因为不想引人注目，也基本和她没有来往，就这样作为普通的同学度过着平凡的每一天。

そんなある日、親友の雄太郎に呼び出され向かった屋上で出会ったのは、クラスで浮いている電波少女・アオイ。
一天，心一被好友雄太郎叫到了屋顶，不过在那里他遇见的、却是无法融入班级的电波少女・向日葵。

「ビリビリ、するの？」そんな言葉とともに、突然キスを迫られた心一。偶然居合わせた美雪に助けられ、なんとかその場は切り抜けたが、それ以後アオイに奇妙につきまとわれるようになる。
“要来，哔哩哔哩么？”向日葵一边这么说着，一边逼近心一要和他接吻。不过凑巧被当时在场的美雪帮了一把才勉强逃掉，不过事后他却依然不断的被向日葵纠缠。

友達もなく、人間らしい感情を持たないアオイ。彼女に友達との付き合い方を教えてやりたくて、意を決して美雪に頼み込み、3人で時間を過ごすことに。
面对既没有朋友，也没有人类应有情感的向日葵。心一想要教会她与人的交流方式，于是下定决心拜托美雪。就这样，三人凑在了一起。

日が経つにつれ、徐々に人間らしい感情に目覚めていくアオイ。一方美雪も、幼い頃無理矢理押さえ込んでいた心一への想いが蘇り、徐々に主人公との距離を詰めていく。せっかく友達同士になれたのに、日に日にギクシャクしていく3人の関係。
随着时间的推移，向日葵也开始逐渐的唤醒了人类应有的情感。另一方面，美雪自幼抑制着的对心一的感情也开始唤醒，不断的缩短和心一的距离。好不容易成为了朋友的三人，关系却变得日渐尴尬起来。


ずっと、一緒にいられると思ってた——
本以为会一直在一起的——

でも、3人ではもう、いられない——
但是已经不能在一起的三人——

主人公が選ぶのは美雪か、それともアオイか……？
心一会选择的，到底会是美雪，还是向日葵……？

game.brief:
A visual novel that pushes the boundaries of the format in unique and stunning ways, YOU and ME and HER: A Love Story has to be played to be believed. When Shinichi decides to help the class outcast Aoi, he enlists the help of Miyuki, the most popular girl in school. But when romance enters the picture, the triangle becomes unstable and the future becomes uncertain. Gorgeous artwork by Tsuji Santa and full voice acting by the original Japanese VA cast make YOU and ME and HER a love story you’ll never forget. Story 
  Life is like a staircase. You just gotta keep climbing. Otherwise, if you start to overthink it, you'll have trouble taking the next step. 
 
 Shinichi wants nothing more than to lead a quiet life. Though he was once close friends with Miyuki, the most popular girl in school, his desire for normalcy now keeps them from being anything more than classmates.
 
 Everything changes, however, one day on the roof, when the class oddball, Aoi, suddenly tries to kiss him. Miyuki appears just in time to stop her, but afterward, Shinichi feels the urge to bring some light to this friendless girl's eyes. He enlists Miyuki's aid, and thus, a trio is born.
 
 The days pass, and little by little, Aoi learns what it means to be friends. But at the same time, long-dormant feelings awaken in Miyuki's heart. As the distance between her and Shinichi shrinks, the hard-earned bonds the three share begin to fray.
 
 Miyuki or Aoi－when the time comes, which will Shinichi choose? Game Description 
  YOU and ME and HER: A Love Story  is a multi-path visual novel from acclaimed developer Nitro+. It features beautiful artwork, music, and Japanese voice acting with full English text. Direct the story by making decisions at key points in the narrative. The ending is yours to decide.

最早由传奇游戏设计大师席德·梅尔创作出来的《文明》是一款回合制策略游戏，让玩家尝试建立起一个帝国，并接受时间的考验。玩家将创建及带领自己的文明从石器时代迈向信息时代，并成为世界的领导者。在尝试建立起世界上赫赫有名的伟大文明的过程中，玩家将启动战争、实行外交、促进文化，同时正面对抗历史上的众多伟大领袖。

《文明VI》带给玩家与世界互动的新方式：城市现在可以在地图上实际地扩张，积极钻研科技和文化可以解锁新潜能，互相竞争的领袖会依据历史所记载的个人特征去追求自我宗旨，而且玩家可通过五种方式之一取得游戏胜利。

扩张帝国
让您以前所未有的方式看着帝国在地图上扩张壮大。每座城市都会占用多个格子，让您可以自行建设城市以充分运用当地的地形。
积极探索
解锁能加速文明历史进程的促进项目。若要进展地更快速，派您的单位积极探索、发展您的环境，以及发现新文化。
动态外交
与其他文明之间的互动会随着游戏的进行而改变。原始时代的初次互动可能是避免不了的战争冲突，但到游戏后期的互动将会转变成结盟与协商。
军力结合
以“每格一单位”的设计概念去做扩展，支援单位现在可以嵌入其他单位，例如反坦克单位支援步兵，战士支援拓荒者。类似的单位也可以结合在一起形成强大的“军团”单位。
更上层楼的多人游戏
除了传统的多人游戏模式外，还可以在众多各式各样的情境下（全都设计成可在一场游戏时间里轻松完成）与您的好友合作及对抗。
适合所有玩家的《文明》游戏
《文明VI》提供了老玩家建立及调整文明的新方式，让他们有最大的机会取得成功。新的教学系统能让新玩家理解游戏的根本概念，帮助他们轻松上手。

《文明VI》（英语：Sid Meier's Civilization VI，中国大陆译作“文明VI”，台港译作“文明帝国VI”）是由Firaxis Games开发的回合策略游戏，是文明系列的最新作品，同时是庆祝该系列25周年的作品。

与以往作品一样，《文明帝国VI》让玩家在单人或多人模式中建立并发展自己的文明，甚至控制地球的命运。游戏的胜利条件基于数个基础，包括探索、扩大、利用和消灭。玩家建立城市、改善及扩张城市，并建立军事单位以探索和攻击敌对势力，同时管理文明的技术发展及对外关系。

本作的玩法基本上与《文明帝国V》相同，地图仍然使用著六角地图，但亦增加了部份新系统及功能。在本作中，玩家需要规划在城市控制范围内的各种地块上的“城区”，不同地块会为城区会提供不同的加成，但有一定的局限性。例如，山地地形有助于观察星空，因此能为校园型城区提供特殊的加成，但同时森林或丛林地形又能供大学和研究室在生物群落内研究物种多样性以反映科学的进步，因此玩家需要仔细选择。此外，玩家可以选择攻击一个特定城区而非城市中心，从而影响城市的运作。但是，玩家能于城区中新增新战略以增加城市的防卫。例如在城区设置军事营地，当敌方队伍接近城市，他们除了遭受来自城市的攻击外，亦会被军事营地攻击，令他们可能需要转为攻击军事营地，再夺取城市。首席设计师Ed Beach将这些变化视为一种有益的手段，将城市的建筑分散在不同地块上，就好像Jon Shafer（文明V的首席设计师）在《文明帝国V》时分散单元格一样。这些功能增添了模拟城市类游戏的城市管理要素，有助使玩家认为经营及管理城市是基于城市的地理位置，而非根据一个特定城市的改进路线基础。

为了减少在地图上出现拥挤，玩家将能够进行单元堆叠，但只能堆放类似单位或共生单位。例如，战士支援拓荒者。类似的单位也可以结合在一起形成强大的“军团”单位。

game.title: Beholder
game.description:
Welcome to a grim dystopian future.

 A totalitarian State controls every aspect of private and public life.
 Laws are oppressive. Surveillance is total. Privacy is dead.
 
 You are the State-installed manager of an apartment building. Your daily routine involves making the building a sweet spot for tenants, who will come and go. However, that is simply a facade that hides your real mission...

 Your primary task is to covertly watch your tenants and eavesdrop on their conversations. You must BUG their apartments while they're away, SEARCH their belongings for whatever can threaten the authority of the State, and PROFILE them for your superiors. You must also REPORT anyone capable of violating the laws or plotting subversive activities against the State to the authorities.

 You are a cog in a totalitarian machine with your own family who also has needs. Do you cling to your humanity and cover up your tenants? Or do you survive by staying loyal to the regime? The choice is yours.
 
 You can report the suspicious activities of a father but orphan his children. Or you can withhold the details about his illegal activities and give him a chance to make things right? Or you can blackmail him to earn something your family.
 
 As you play the game, you'll interact with many characters and complete dozens of quests. You'll also make decisions that will affect the way the story unfolds. This will lead to one of several game endings — the ending you have earned!

Racconta le tue storie a modo tuo mentre sviluppi relazioni, intraprendi carriere, persegui aspirazioni di vita e ti immergi in questo gioco straordinario dalle infinite possibilità.

game.title: This War of Mine
game.description:
In This War Of Mine you do not play as an elite soldier, rather a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers. The game provides an experience of war seen from an entirely new angle.

The pace of This War of Mine is imposed by the day and night cycle. During the day snipers outside stop you from leaving your refuge, so you need to focus on maintaining your hideout: crafting, trading and taking care of your survivors. At night, take one of your civilians on a mission to scavenge through a set of unique locations for items that will help you stay alive.

Make life-and-death decisions driven by your conscience. Try to protect everybody from your shelter or sacrifice some of them for longer-term survival. During war, there are no good or bad decisions; there is only survival. The sooner you realize that, the better.

  About the Game  Recently updated with This War of Mine: Final Cut! 
 This War of Mine: Final Cut is the conclusive, remastered edition of the game that contains all the updates and free expansions released so far and introduces not only a new scenario but also expands all scenarios with the locations known from Stories DLCs - even if you don’t own those. In short words - that means you can now experience lots of never-seen-before playthroughs and struggle with new challenges.
 
 
  
 
 It has been a long road. However, all stories must come to an end.
 
 This War of Mine has been giving you a thrilling experience of living through the war as a civilian for five years since its release. Numerous updates and expansions have broadened the experience and filled it with more shades and tonalities of hard civilian existence during wartime. Now, honoring the 5th anniversary of the original release, 11 bit studios proudly presents to you This War of Mine: Final Cut.
 
 This War of Mine: Final Cut contains all the updates and free expansions released so far and introduces not only a new scenario but also expands all scenarios with the locations known from Stories DLCs - even if you don’t own those. In short words - that means you can now experience lots of never-seen-before playthroughs and struggle with new challenges. Major changes and new content:   One new classic scenario
   All locations from TWoM Stories added to the original game
   New quests and Events on Stories locations
   Remastered versions of all the classic locations
   A brand-new character
   Vanilla version of the game   Minor changes and tweaks:   64bit and 32bit version
   21:9 aspect ratio support
   4k UI adjustments
   new main menu
   additional smaller bugfixes and tweaks   To launch the Vanilla version of This War of Mine:   Right-click on the game in your Steam Library.
   Go to Properties -> Betas.
   From the drop-down list, choose vanilla - This War of Mine: Original Release 1.0
   Close the window and update the game  
  This War of Mine: Final Cut  marks an end of an era for 11 bit studios, so let’s hear what the art director Przemyslaw Marszal, the person who created the unique style of This War of Mine, has to say: “We wanted to put the last touch to this phenomenon. The phenomenon, which made us who we are today as a team, equally in terms of creative fearlessness and business direction, and helped us pave our further way. Fantastic support from the gaming community was a huge part of that success, so it was without any doubt that this update must be free. We think of the Final Cut as a closing episode to the one-of-a-kind series This War of Mine has been. It will remain precious to our hearts and I don’t know what ideas the future will bring but Final Cut is final by no means. The creative minds in our studio, who were with the game up to this point, started to pursue new challenges. So we're excited about what's coming.” ABOUT THIS WAR OF MINE: 
  
 
 In This War Of Mine you do not play as an elite soldier, rather a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers. The game provides an experience of war seen from an entirely new angle.
 
 The pace of This War of Mine is imposed by the day and night cycle. During the day snipers outside stop you from leaving your refuge, so you need to focus on maintaining your hideout: crafting, trading and taking care of your survivors. At night, take one of your civilians on a mission to scavenge through a set of unique locations for items that will help you stay alive.
 
 Make life-and-death decisions driven by your conscience. Try to protect everybody from your shelter or sacrifice some of them for longer-term survival. During war, there are no good or bad decisions; there is only survival. The sooner you realize that, the better.
 
   This War of Mine - main features:   Inspired by real-life events
   Control your survivors and manage your shelter
   Craft weapons, alcohol, beds or stoves – anything that helps you survive
   Make decisions - an often unforgiving and emotionally difficult experience
   Randomized world and characters every time you start a new game
   Charcoal-stylized aesthetics to complement the game's theme  
   The universe of This War of Mine has been expanded by following DLCs:    The Little Ones  - explores the hardships of wartime survival as seen from an entirely new perspective - that of a child.
    This War of Mine: Anniversary Edition  - this free DLC, created especially for the 2nd Anniversary of the game, adds new characters, new locations to explore, and most importantly - a whole new ending, leading to a different outcome to the game. The dilemma though remains the same – how far will you go, to protect the ones you care about?
    This War of Mine: Stories DLCs:    Episode 1: The Father's Promise  –  a heartbreaking tale of loss and hope in a war-torn city
    Episode 2: The Last Broadcast  – where, as a radio operator, you are going to face moral dilemmas and decide, whether there is a price too high for the truth
    Episode 3: Fading Embers  – portrays a story of Anja living in a warzone and carrying a heavy burden as she has to answer to herself what is more important - survival of human legacy or the survival of a man
